plan.objective: Establish recorded term end, notice deadline and signature position. If there is no current signed term, lead with the last expired term and pending execution. Use CRM, usage, service and notes to decide what must be confirmed now.

evidence.text: Varrow Racing Authority is recorded as a Core League/Federation account in FR, owned by Tomas Ferreira, with a customer-since date of 2021-10-01.
Expired signed contract K-0011 covered the term from 2024-10-01 through 2026-09-30 and recorded €189,000 in ARR during that term.
Contract K-0045 is marked pending signature, with a proposed term from 2026-10-01 through 2028-09-30 and proposed ARR of €200,000. The draft is outside signed coverage.

The most recent confirmed signed term, K-0011, ended on 2026-09-30, 32 days before the snapshot. That term's recorded notice deadline was 2026-07-02. The available records show no signed term covering the snapshot.
caveats: Notice delivery and waivers are absent from the available records. The recorded rule does not establish renewal execution.

evidence.text: The snapshot does not confirm any signed in-force product holdings or current ARR.
caveats: Current product scope and signed fees remain uncertain until executed terms are confirmed.

evidence.text: CRM lists the renewal opportunity O-0005 at Negotiation. The proposed ARR is €200,000. The recorded expected close was 2026-09-30 and has passed. Recorded CRM next step is ‘Legal review of data-rights clause’.
